defect_found_and_fixed: package/T970UsbProbe.cpp:49 t970_usb_start existed but no linked translation unit called it: this port links package/T970Power/BatteryService.cpp as its battery implementation, which did not start the USB stack, while the reference started it from package/T970Battery.cpp:456-461. Fixed by calling t970_usb_start() at the end of t970_battery_start (package/T970Power/BatteryService.cpp:317) and widening the MUIC wait from 600 to 1800 x 100 ms (package/T970UsbProbe.cpp:55), because this port routes the MUIC from the battery poll loop instead of a fixed delay.

observation.owner_words: USB识别到iPad了，但是无法信任，因为平板上没有弹出信任窗口。
observation.notes: The Mac enumerated the tablet over USB device mode on this image: the device-mode stack began for the first time. Finder could not pair because the tablet showed no trust dialog; the display at that moment drew every window under the same white-surface defect the desktop widgets showed, so an invisible dialog is one candidate and an unanswering lockdownd the other. No usbmuxd or lockdownd transcript was captured.

verification_hint: scripts/mac-usb-check.py prints ioreg -p IOUSB (Apple vendor 0x05ac), the usbmuxd ListDevices socket and lockdownd QueryType over port 62078.
